subject: multiple entry for one CpG site

messages.author: 9d6d84d6262e8bec
messages.subject: multiple entry for one CpG site
parts:
Hi,

I noticed a curious thing in few of my CpG.txt file that has been genereated from SAM file by methylKit.

I found several entries for a single CpG site and they show different methylation file. I intially thought it might be a bug
and I repeated the run and repeated again with the latest version but found same results.

So for example it looks like this,

chrBase    chr    base    strand    coverage    freqC    freqT

13.53982868    13    53982868    R    17    100.00    0.00
13.53982868    13    53982868    R    13    0.00    100.00
13.53982868    13    53982868    R    19    21.05    78.95

There are several other examples of similar sorts and the difference in methylation worries me.

Any comments please.

Aniruddha Chatterjee
Post doc, University of Otago, New Zealand.

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] multiple entry for one CpG site
parts:
You have to give a little bit more information. Which version of bowtie are you using?Are your reads paired? Is the file sorted. If it is, can you send 100 lines of SAM file that covers and around chr13 :53982868, meaning that I need the subsection of the sorted file that covers that location and nearby bases.

The only thing I can think of is that your file is not sorted or there might be something wrong (or unexpected) with the file format. INDELS used to be a problem with bowtie2 but it should be fixed by now.

Best,

Altuna

messages.author: 9d6d84d6262e8bec
messages.subject: Re: multiple entry for one CpG site
parts:
Thanks Altuna. I will check the sorting again and get back if problem persists. We have used Bowtie1 for Bismark alignment here.

Aniruddha.
